title: TRINEXIS: An Alert-Aware, Interval-Throttled Open-Vocabulary Webcam System with Language-Configured Speech
description: Repository-fixed TRINEXIS software and standalone technical report. The paper documents an alert-aware, interval-throttled open-vocabulary webcam pipeline with language-configured speech, deterministic software verification, AGPL-3.0 licensing, and a weights checksum script. No empirical detection, latency, distance-calibration, or user-study result is claimed.
